EARTH LUXE Eco-Friendly Gift Set COLLECTION – A

The EARTH LUXE Eco-Friendly Gift Set COLLECTION – A is a thoughtfully curated premium sustainable gift hamper designed for corporate gifting, festive gifting, employee appreciation, events and eco-conscious celebrations. This luxury eco-friendly gift set combines renewable materials like cork, bamboo and seed paper with wellness items such as pure honey, beeswax candle and incense sticks to create a meaningful, planet-positive gifting experience.

As demand for eco-friendly gifts and sustainable corporate gift sets rises across India, the EARTH LUXE Eco-Friendly Gift Set COLLECTION – A stands out as a comprehensive, high-utility, zero-plastic gift option. Every element in this eco-conscious gift box is designed to support sustainability, reduce waste and offer long-term usability. Its combination of organic, reusable and plantable items ranks it among the most popular choices for companies looking to adopt ESG-compliant gifting.

What’s Inside the EARTH LUXE Eco-Friendly Gift Set COLLECTION – A

  • Cork Tray (8.5”x8.5”) – Durable, biodegradable and perfect for home or office use.
  • Honey (2 Flavours) – Pure, natural honey packed in recyclable jars for a healthy touch.
  • Beeswax Candle – Chemical-free, smoke-free and ideal for stress relief and aromatherapy.
  • Cork Coaster Set (4 pcs) – Eco-friendly coasters offering natural insulation and charm.
  • Eco-Friendly Playing Cards – Made from recyclable materials for sustainable fun.
  • Plantable Pen & Pencil Set (2+2) – Seed paper stationery that grows into plants after use.
  • Cork Organizer (3”x3”x7”) – Minimalist desk organizer crafted from natural cork.
  • Plantable Calendar (3.5”x5”) – Eco-friendly yearly calendar made with seed paper.
  • Cork Journal cum Planner (A5) – Sustainable cork cover journal for daily planning.
  • Bamboo Bottle (450ml) – Non-toxic, reusable bottle with natural insulation.
  • Cork Floating Diya – Lightweight, traditional diya made from natural cork.
  • Incense Stick Pack (20 sticks) – Calming aroma sticks made using natural materials.
  • Cork Sticky Note (3”x3”) – Renewable, sustainable alternative to paper sticky notes.
  • Chocolate in a Cork Bag – Premium treat wrapped in an eco-friendly cork pouch.
  • Cork MDF Box (11”x10”x3.5”) – A premium, reusable gift box that completes the packaging.

Why Choose the EARTH LUXE Eco-Friendly Gift Set COLLECTION – A?

This eco-friendly corporate gift set is crafted for organizations that value sustainability, branding impact and thoughtful gifting. The combination of cork accessories, bamboo bottle, plantable stationery and wellness elements makes it both luxurious and environmentally responsible.

The EARTH LUXE Eco-Friendly Gift Set COLLECTION – A is ideal for:

  • Corporate festive gifting
  • Employee joining kits
  • Sustainable corporate events
  • Client appreciation gifts
  • Eco-friendly celebration hampers

With rising awareness around green gifts and sustainable lifestyle accessories, this eco-focused gift box is an excellent choice for businesses aiming to reduce their environmental impact while offering premium and memorable gifts. The thoughtful combination of natural materials, useful products and elegant cork packaging makes it a top-rated option in the eco-friendly corporate gifting category.
